sources.transformation: Selected completed, occupied, UBC-jurisdiction student-facing buildings with official codes; retained official footprints and current mapped entrances; converted pedestrian-access route coordinates into graph nodes and edges. Entrance-to-route connectors of at most 20 metres are routing inferences and are explicitly marked inferred. Entrance accessibility, public access, hours, and door semantics are not inferred.
